model_fit.zero_head_prior: Both models use Euler body displacement=dt*command rotated by the current yaw, with endpoint twist=command; this is not identical to the older midpoint-yaw kinematic_step

protocol.interpretation: Both learned models are factual system identification, not joint policy learning. Known three-condition development task, not unseen-scene generalization. No task-self-cost in fitting. Full-state exact rollout remains privileged and uses full geometry; other three use the same nominal footprint.

complete_execution_ledger.scope: New collection, model fitting and twelve completed task cases only; prior frozen-study work is not rerun or charged twice. Installation/transfer/setup wall time is outside the recorded stage sum.

old_baseline_reproduction.scope: Task/physical outputs only; new runtime timings are independently retained

protocol.purpose: Frozen-policy complete-task development benchmark; no learning or hardware
protocol.online_information: Both MPC variants use current full simulator state and frozen policy history; future disturbance is not provided. Policy rollout has privileged exact nominal physics; no hardware-realism claim.

limitations: 同一已知scene、route及三种已知条件的开发比较，不是未见任务、平台或地形泛化。
本轮允许拟合事实响应模型；冻结策略参数更新必须单独计为零，不能把模型拟合叫策略学习。
单步和多步模型同更新次数不等于同前反向计算或同墙钟；分别报告完整账本。
在线预测误差对应被选命令的下一宏步；不是全部候选的误差，也不是独立五步开环精度。
不同控制器的在线RMSE来自各自访问的状态/命令，不能直接当作同查询模型精度比较；共同验证窗口才提供匹配输入的精度对照。
未来外力不交给预测器，推扰宏步与普通宏步分别报告；预测更准不自动等于完整任务更好。
200ms判断使用每次完整控制周期的p95、最大值与超期比例；平均时间不能代替它们。
本机/服务器观察到的耗时不构成NX时延、实机控制频率或硬实时保证。
最终成功按真实MuJoCo轨迹、全身几何、接触及时间戳保持判断，不借用紧凑预测的未来接触或关节状态。
两个学习模型与kinematic使用同一航向矩形proxy；exact policy rollout仍拥有完整名义物理/几何，属于额外信息的特权对照。
学习模型共同零输出先验为当前yaw的Euler位移，旧kinematic使用midpoint yaw，两者不被混称为完全相同先验。
失败或算力截断全部保留；早停失败的小累计成本不用于宣称胜过成功任务。
只有少量确定性开发轨迹，不做统计显著性或总体鲁棒性结论。
